Mini Parity API — GET /widgets
List widgets
Returns every widget the caller may see.
Parameters:
- limit (query): integer — Page size.
Responses: 200 A page of widgets.; 401 No credentials.

Mini Parity API — POST /widgets
Create a widget
Request body:
- name: string (required) — The widget name.
- size: integer — Size in cells.
Responses: 201 The new widget.

Mini Parity API — DELETE /widgets/{id}
Delete a widget
Parameters:
- id (path): string (required) — The widget id.
Responses: 204 Deleted.; 404 No such widget.
